name: Monkey D. Luffy
biography: Captain of the Straw Hat Pirates, Luffy ate the Gum-Gum Fruit (Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika), granting his body rubber properties and liberating laughter to all who suffer.
quotes: I'm gonna be the King of the Pirates!
If you don't take risks, you can't create a future.

name: Satoru Gojo
biography: The strongest Jujutsu sorcerer alive, bearer of both the Limitless cursed technique and the Six Eyes, serving as a mentor to students at Tokyo Jujutsu High.
quotes: Throughout Heaven and Earth, I alone am the honored one.
Don't worry, I'm the strongest.

name: Frieren
biography: An elven mage who traveled for ten years with Hero Himmel's party to defeat the Demon King. Following Himmel's death, she embarks on a pilgrimage to Ende to speak with him once more.
quotes: It was only a ten-year journey... why am I crying?
Demons are monsters that speak words only to deceive.

name: Tanjiro Kamado
biography: A kindhearted boy whose family is slaughtered by Muzan Kibutsuji, setting him on a quest to become a Demon Slayer and turn his demon sister Nezuko human again.
quotes: No matter how many people you may lose, you have no choice but to go on living.
Set your heart ablaze!

name: Levi Ackerman
japaneseName: リヴァイ・アッカーマン
biography: Humanity's Strongest Soldier and captain of the Special Operations Squad in the Survey Corps, known for peerless combat efficiency and a fastidious obsession with cleanliness.
quotes: Give up on your dreams and die for us.
The only thing we're allowed to do is believe that we won't regret the choice we made.

name: Malenia, Blade of Miquella
biography: Demigod daughter of Queen Marika and Radagon, born afflicted with Scarlet Rot. Known as the undefeated swordstress who fought General Radahn to a standstill.
quotes: I am Malenia, Blade of Miquella, and I have never known defeat.
Let your flesh be consumed by the scarlet rot.

name: Geralt of Rivia
biography: A mutated monster hunter known as the White Wolf, traversing the war-torn Northern Kingdoms in search of his adopted ward Ciri before the Wild Hunt catches her.
quotes: Evil is evil. Lesser, greater, middling, it's all the same.
Wind's howling.

name: Kratos
biography: Former Spartan general and God of War who destroyed Mount Olympus, now seeking redemption and raising his son Atreus in the unforgiving Norse realms.
quotes: Do not be sorry. Be better.
Wars are won by those who are willing to sacrifice everything.

name: Jin Sakai
biography: A samurai lord who must discard strict samurai code of honor to adopt unconventional guerilla tactics as 'The Ghost' to liberate Tsushima Island from the Mongol invasion.
quotes: Honor died on the beach.
I sacrificed everything for my people. I would do it again.

name: Ellie Williams
series: The Last of Us Part II
biography: The only known immune human to the Cordyceps brain infection, Ellie is driven by deep trauma, love, and a devastating pursuit of vengeance across post-apocalyptic Seattle.
quotes: If I ever were to lose you, I'd surely lose myself.
I have to finish it.

name: Bruce Wayne (The Batman)
biography: In his second year of fighting crime in Gotham City, Bruce Wayne stalks the shadows as a nocturnal vigilante seeking to punish criminals until he realizes Gotham needs a beacon of hope.
quotes: I'm vengeance.
People need hope. To know someone's out there for them.

name: Paul Atreides
biography: Heir of House Atreides who embraces the ways of the desert Fremen as Usul and Muad'Dib, reluctantly fulfilling a prophecy that threatens to ignite a galaxy-wide holy war.
quotes: Lead them to paradise!
May thy knife chip and shatter.

name: Alita
biography: Rebuilt from a 300-year-old cyborg core found in the Scrapyard, Alita rediscovers Panzer Kunst, an ancient Martian martial art, and rises through the dangerous ranks of Motorball.
quotes: I do not stand by in the presence of evil.
I'd rather die than live without you.

name: Miles Morales
biography: Brooklyn's teenage Spider-Man who defies the multiversal Spider-Society's doctrine of fatalistic 'canon events' to forge his own destiny and protect his loved ones.
quotes: Nah, imma do my own thing.
Everyone tells me how my story is supposed to go.

name: Ellen Ripley
biography: Warrant officer aboard the commercial freighter Nostromo who becomes humanity's foremost survivor and tactical fighter against the extraterrestrial Xenomorph species.
quotes: Get away from her, you b***h!
I can't lie to you about your chances, but you have my sympathies.

name: Joel Miller
biography: A grieving father turned ruthless black-market smuggler in Boston QZ whose escort mission across the country with Ellie reawakens his lost capacity to love.
quotes: You keep finding something to fight for.
I'd do it all over again.

name: Lord Yoshii Toranaga
biography: Lord of the Kanto and descendant of the Minowara clan, an unmatched grandmaster of psychological warfare and patience who outmaneuvers rivals to become Shōgun.
quotes: Why tell a dead man future plans?
I do not control the wind; I study it.

name: Daemon Targaryen
biography: The Rogue Prince of Westeros and dragonrider of Caraxes the Blood Wyrm, wielding the Valyrian steel blade Dark Sister in support of Queen Rhaenyra's claim.
quotes: Dreams didn't make us kings. Dragons did.
Ten thousand men cannot stand before a dragon.

name: Lucy MacLean
biography: An idealistic Vault 33 dweller who leaves the subterranean sanctuary into the radiated California wasteland to rescue her abducted father Overseer Hank MacLean.
quotes: Okie Dokie!
The golden rule: do unto others as you would have them do unto you.

name: Walter White / Heisenberg
biography: A mild-mannered high school chemistry teacher diagnosed with terminal lung cancer who descends into the Albuquerque narcotics underworld to become kingpin Heisenberg.
quotes: I am the one who knocks!
Say my name.

name: Jungkook (Jeon Jung-kook)
biography: Main vocalist, lead dancer, and sub-rapper of BTS, known affectionately worldwide as the 'Golden Maknae' for his vocal tone and Billboard Hot 100 #1 solo hits like 'Seven'.
quotes: Effort makes you. You will regret someday if you don't do your best now.
ARMY is our galaxy.

name: Jennie Kim
biography: Main rapper and lead vocalist of BLACKPINK, global fashion icon (Chanel ambassador), and founder of OA (ODD ATELIER), known for fierce stage aura and vocal dynamics.
quotes: I'm shining solo.
Stay true to who you are, no matter the noise.

name: Felix (Lee Yong-bok)
biography: Lead dancer and sub-rapper of Stray Kids, internationally famed for his deep cavernous bass vocal tone, freckled visual charm, and intricate dance performance skills.
quotes: Cooking like a chef, I'm a 5-star Michelin.
Stay will always be my safe place.

name: Karina (Yu Ji-min)
biography: Leader, main dancer, and face of the conceptual meta-universe group aespa, celebrated for AI-like visuals, martial dance precision, and vocal adaptability.
quotes: We are navigating between worlds.
Never lose the sparkle that makes you special.

name: Hanni (Phạm Ngọc Hân)
biography: Vietnamese-Australian vocalist and dancer of NewJeans who cowrote global hits 'Hype Boy' and 'OMG', known for sweet vocal timbre and acoustic guitar versatility.
quotes: Music is a universal language that heals us.
I want to share the joy we feel on stage.

name: Batman (Bruce Wayne)
biography: The legendary World's Greatest Detective of DC Comics, forged in tragedy following his parents' murder in Crime Alley, using intellect and human perfection to combat terror.
quotes: Criminals are a superstitious and cowardly lot.
Deep down, Clark is essentially a good person... and deep down, I'm not.
actorOrVoice: Created by Bob Kane & Bill Finger

name: Spider-Man (Peter Parker)
biography: Bitten by a radioactive spider as a Queens high schooler, Peter learned Uncle Ben's lesson that with great power comes great responsibility, balancing everyday troubles with heroism.
quotes: With great power comes great responsibility.
No matter how many times I get knocked down, I always get back up.
actorOrVoice: Created by Stan Lee & Steve Ditko

name: Dream / Morpheus
biography: The Lord of Dreams, Monarch of the Dreaming realm, and one of the seven cosmic Endless who anthropomorphize the fundamental forces of the universe.
quotes: Things need not have happened to be true.
It is a foolish thing to defy the Lord of Dreams.

name: Invincible (Mark Grayson)
biography: Son of Earth's greatest champion Omni-Man, Mark inherits Viltrumite powers and must face the brutal truth of his heritage and save civilizations across the galaxy.
quotes: I'll still have you, Dad.
Being a hero isn't about being invincible; it's about standing back up.
actorOrVoice: Created by Robert Kirkman & Cory Walker

name: Wolverine (Logan)
biography: A mutant born with animal-keen senses, enhanced physical capabilities, and a healing factor, whose skeleton and retractable claws were bonded with indestructible Adamantium.
quotes: I'm the best there is at what I do, but what I do isn't very nice.
Nature made me a freak. Man made me a weapon.
actorOrVoice: Created by Len Wein, John Romita Sr. & Herb Trimpe

name: Guts (The Black Swordsman)
biography: Born from a corpse and raised by mercenaries, Guts survives the horrors of the Eclipse and battles apostles of the God Hand with his gargantuan sword, the Dragon Slayer.
quotes: He who fights with monsters must take care lest he thereby become a monster.
Struggle, challenge, and rise against fate.

name: Sung Jin-woo
biography: The world's weakest E-rank hunter chosen as the sole Player of the mysterious System, ascending through impossible trials to inherit the throne of the Shadow Monarch Ashborn.
quotes: Arise.
The only one who can protect my family is me.

name: Thorfinn Karlsefni
biography: Once a bloodthirsty young warrior bent on revenge against Askeladd, Thorfinn undergoes a profound spiritual transformation during his enslavement into a committed apostle of peace.
quotes: A true warrior doesn't need a sword.
I will create a land where there is no slavery or war.

name: Ken Kaneki
biography: A mild literature student transformed into an artificial one-eyed ghoul after an organ transplant, caught between human morals and the monstrous cannibal hunger of ghouls.
quotes: I'm not the protagonist of a novel... I'm a ghoul.
Why is it that beautiful things are entwined with death?

name: Denji
biography: An impoverished boy drowning in yakuza debt who merges with the Chainsaw Devil Pochita to become Chainsaw Man, joining Public Safety Devil Hunters for toast with jam and hugs.
quotes: Everybody's after my chainsaw heart! What about Denji's heart?!
If having dreams means this much pain, I'd rather just sleep.

name: Patrick Jane
biography: A consultant with the California Bureau of Investigation (CBI), Jane uses hyper-acute observational skills, mentalism, and cold reading to solve baffling homicides while tracking Red John.
quotes: There is no such thing as psychics... just keen observation and psychology.
The mind is a wonderful organ. It starts working the moment you get up in the morning, and does not stop until you get into the office.

name: Raymond "Red" Reddington
biography: Known as the "Concierge of Crime", former US Naval Intelligence officer Raymond Reddington turned fugitive now orchestrates the downfall of the world's most clandestine criminals through his personal Blacklist.
quotes: Value loyalty above all else.
There are no second chances in life, except to feel remorse.

name: Lucia Caminos
biography: One half of GTA VI's Bonnie & Clyde-style duo alongside Jason, Lucia operates throughout the neon-drenched streets of Vice City and the swamps of Leonida, balancing ambition, loyalty, and survival.
quotes: Trust? Trust is everything.
The only way we're gonna get through this is by sticking together.

name: Izuku Midoriya (Deku)
biography: Born Quirkless in a superhuman society, Midoriya inherited the legendary One For All Quirk from the symbol of peace, All Might, devoting every ounce of his soul to saving everyone with a smile.
quotes: I have to work harder than anyone else to make it! I'll never catch up otherwise!
A smiling, dependable, cool hero... That's what I wanna be!
